reviewer: Codex inspection of actual production Canvas, every source frame, mixed poses and isolated headless Chromium screenshots
observations: Four sides of paired benches enclose the shared fire; paths meet both timber gateways and the radio remains outside the seating ring.
Open ball clearing, isolated trampoline landing area, connected corner fence and separated entrance communicate play and return paths.
Two official game covers fit new gallery displays on one viewing line; branching entrance path stops at the accessible fronts.
All sixteen seat contacts align with bench tops, four jacket directions face inward; profiles remain round and upright, legs visible, names avoid nearby heads.

All 16 states and four seated body views are new. Removed white wave panels and replaced standing crouch frame. Source/mixed sheets show stable portrait scale, overhead carry hands and intact lower poses.
All sixteen linked players fit vertically in the actual renderer; overhead arms support the next body and portraits/name hit regions remain distinct.
Actual desktop/mobile open conversation, focus, tabs and draft preservation verified with the full new manifest.
Mobile portrait scale and empty radio are compact; fire controls stay clear of movement controls.
Desktop and mobile retain visible 200x200 video. Mobile fire tools move to the opposite side, stand button fits and mute/navigation targets remain reachable.
notes: Final full UI run recorded two settled native ResizeObserver notifications during PIP/viewport transitions. Dev-only overlays were dismissed after notifications stopped; error events were not suppressed.
Dark environment/effect edges were graded on fresh transparent surfaces; default bench includes a usable frame as well as both strict direction bindings.
